shots.label: The main menu over the idle board: start a run, settings, quit
shots.notes: What the build opens on. No run has started; the board behind is the match root, idle.

shots.label: The settings screen: player name, lobby folder, display, resolution, each with what honouring it costs
shots.notes: Volume is not shown: the game makes no sound, so there is nothing for it to honour.

shots.label: A run played to its end: what it came to, and the way back to the menu
shots.notes: The scripted player plays every round it can; the header's one button reads the way back.
